races.name: racingtv.com Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Birkenhead
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner with good course record, 43 days off but solid AW comeback second suggests readiness
runners_data.comment: Good track record and won this off the same mark last year; firmly in calculations
runners_data.spotlight: The old man of the party but he still likes to get on with it and has a good record here; solid comeback second on AW in January wasn't built on but he's back down to the same mark he won this race from last year; that was a fourth C&D win and he has to enter calculations.

runners_data.name: Nacho Nacho Nacho
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with AW win in visor, 75 days off is a concern for sharp 5f contest
runners_data.comment: Sports a new headgear combination for just his third start on turf and second at 5f
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark for this yard when making most to land Wolverhampton handicap (7f, AW; first-time visor) at the end of last year; weakened over 6f at that track when last seen; sports a new headgear combination for just his third start on turf and second at 5f.

runners_data.name: Tommy McJohn
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with winning nursery form in blinkers, 89-day absence and poor trainer form worry
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish 5f winner (blinkers); no headgear for yet another stable debut; watch the market
runners_data.spotlight: Won nursery at Naas (good; first-time blinkers) for Michael O'Callaghan in 2024 and was wearing those aids when third of 14 at Dundalk (also 5f, AW) on final start for Ciaran Murphy; no headgear as he starts off for another new yard (his fifth) after three months away; watch for market confidence.

runners_data.name: Miss Rainbow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with C&D form advantage, visor back on after creditable third here two weeks ago
runners_data.comment: Course winner who's won over 5f; creditable third here (6f) latest; much respected
runners_data.spotlight: Four handicap wins last year included one at 5f and another at this track (7f, good); visor reapplied when a creditable third here (6f, good; led) a fortnight ago and she's another who should give it a good go on or near the lead.

runners_data.name: Lucius Aurelius
runners_data.note: Prominent type who's a 16-race maiden but capable, poor draw cost him at Pontefract last time
runners_data.comment: 0-16 but placed all three starts here; excuses on last two starts; breakthrough possible
runners_data.spotlight: 16-race maiden but he's capable and got no run at Southwell (AW) on penultimate start and was poorly drawn at Pontefract (also 5f, good to soft) a fortnight ago; placed on all three starts here and the breakthrough is far from out of the question.

runners_data.name: Fortunate Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with C&D win and good recent form since visor applied, just a week between runs
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; third in this last year; arrives in form from AW; player
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner who also finished third in this last year; has been in good nick since the visor went on, winning a classified at Southwell and Newcastle (February/March) and placed in three handicaps (also 5f, AW) subsequently; can take a grip so today's likely good pace will suit and he gets on well with Conor Whiteley; player.

runners_data.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 2022 C&D win and fourth in this race last year, plugged on from rear recently
runners_data.comment: 1-25 on turf but the win was over C&D; solid fourth in this last year; each-way chance
runners_data.spotlight: 1-25 on turf but the win did come in 2022 C&D novice and he was beaten only 2l when fourth in this last year; could only plug on from the rear in both starts this term (5f, AW) but there's nothing wrong with this mark and he might pick up some pieces if there's a pace meltdown.

runners_data.name: Tuscan Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in excellent form with recent win, up 10lbs but talented claimer takes over
runners_data.comment: Easy win on yard debut (6f, AW); 0-14 on turf & this just a fourth go at 5f; new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Hit the ground running for Adam Kirby and Taryn Langley, scoring easily last month before running well to finish second off this 10lb higher mark ten days later; below that form when fifth last time (again Southwell, 6f, AW) and now switches to turf (0-14) on a rare foray over 5f; regular eyeshields also swapped for cheekpieces so there's some guesswork involved.

runners_data.name: Jamie's Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with light weight advantage, C&D form but nothing went right here two weeks ago
runners_data.comment: Two 5f classified wins on turf in 2024; also has form over C&D; not beyond the pale
runners_data.spotlight: Dual classified winner on a sound surface at 5f in 2024; went close in C&D handicap (good) on her comeback last term and not much went right in that same race on her reappearance a fortnight ago; drawn on the wing when down the field in this race last year but not without a squeak this time.

runners_data.name: Barmyblade
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with C&D win at 33-1 last spring, lost his way since June and 12 days may not be enough
runners_data.comment: C&D winner but he seems to have lost his way; mark fine if he can stage a revival
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times on good ground last spring including over C&D (good; 33-1) on his reappearance; lost his way from June onwards and there were few positives when 14th of 15 on his comeback 12 days ago; has dipped below his last winning mark, though.

races.paceDynamic: Birkenhead is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Miss Rainbow, Lucius Aurelius and Fortunate Star likely to sit just behind rather than challenge early. The majority of the field are hold-up horses including Nacho Nacho Nacho, Tommy McJohn, Let's Go Hugo, Tuscan Point, Jamie's Choice and Barmyblade, which means limited early pressure on the pace. With one leader and a bunched field behind over this sharp 5f at Catterick, the race sets up perfectly for the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems. This tactical scenario strongly favours early pace and prominent runners who can secure good positions from the start.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Birkenhead gets away cleanly and dictates fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old can use his experience to control the race from the front while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind. Miss Rainbow and Fortunate Star can track the leader and benefit from the honest pace but Birkenhead's course form gives him the edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow or Fortunate Star can sit perfectly behind Birkenhead then quicken
scenarios.body: The C&D winners can use their local knowledge and sit in the slipstream before pouncing late when the leader tires. Their recent form edge over the veteran front runner should tell in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and allows the back markers time to organize
scenarios.body: Tuscan Point or Nacho Nacho Nacho could benefit from their recent winning form if they get clear runs through. The lighter weights on some hold-up horses like Jamie's Choice could also count if traffic clears.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get compromised by pace or positioning issues
scenarios.body: Barmyblade showed C&D winning form last spring and could surprise at big odds if Tim Easterby has him ready. Tommy McJohn brings Irish form and the blinkers that helped him win his nursery.

watchPoints.text: Birkenhead breaking slowly would eliminate the main pace angle and create chaos in a field full of hold-up horses
Traffic problems developing in the final furlong as nine hold-up horses try to find room behind limited early pace
Miss Rainbow and Fortunate Star both raced here recently so watch for any jarring up or fitness concerns in preliminaries
Tommy McJohn and Nacho Nacho Nacho both return from lengthy breaks which is risky over this minimum trip
Tuscan Point carrying a 10lb penalty from his recent win but talented 3lb claimer Taryn Langley offsets some of that burden

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Soca Star
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to optimum 5f trip after 193-day absence, needs to prove sharpness first time back for new stable
runners_data.comment: Return to 5f in her favour but headgear is again left off; others look safer
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent over 5f on turf for the Quinns; not at her best when third of five in Wolverhampton novice (6f) on her stable debut 193 days ago; return to 5f in her favour but cheekpieces remain on the sidelines; others safer.

runners_data.name: Naana's Shadow
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent type who showed ability when hampered at Southwell 13 days ago, carries useful recent race fitness edge
runners_data.comment: 5f AW winner for Alice Haynes; encouraging stable debut and should be sharper today
runners_data.spotlight: 5f AW winner for Alice Haynes; ran better than the distance beaten suggests on her stable debut at Southwell two weeks ago, short of room inside the final furlong and eased; that was her first start for 171 days and she could prove a different proposition today.

runners_data.name: Rotokura Belle
runners_data.note: Confirmed 5f specialist with gate speed, won over course and distance 14 days ago with the runner-up subsequently winning
runners_data.comment: Front-running C&D win two weeks ago, beating a subsequent winner; big player up 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: 5f AW win as a 2yo; doubled her haul when showing bright speed to overcome stall 8 over C&D two weeks ago, finding plenty for pressure; the runner-up has won since and a 3lb rise may not prove beyond her.

runners_data.name: Victor Cee
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 106-day layoff, needs to prove stamina holds over this minimum trip under pressure
runners_data.comment: Drops in class and has been gelded; unraced on faster than good; drawn widest
runners_data.spotlight: 6f maiden win for Karl Burke last summer; began life with his new stable with two solid AW efforts but his form dipped at Wolverhampton in January when last seen; drops in class for his return to action (gelded during his absence); unraced on faster than good and drawn widest.

runners_data.name: Come On Over
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner having first start for David O'Meara after 176-day break, distance drop to 5f may suit better
runners_data.comment: Best run for former yard came over 7f & in a visor; likely best watched back from a break
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 for Richard Fahey and Charlie Clover as a 2yo, recording his peak RPR when second of nine, beaten a neck, in a 7f nursery (good to soft; visored first time) at Haydock last September; sold for 16,000 one month later; down in trip for stable debut and goes without headgear.

runners_data.name: Paroda Diva
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective, won over 7f previously so 5f represents significant distance drop
runners_data.comment: Of interest on her best form but that has come over 7f; trip the query this time
runners_data.spotlight: Trained by Stan Moore as a 2yo; won a 7f fillies' maiden (good) last May and ran well at Kempton on her nursery debut in July (7f); ended her 2yo campaign quietly and it was a similar story on her stable debut two weeks ago (6f); drop to 5f the query this time.

runners_data.name: Moretons
runners_data.note: Needs to overcome unfavorable hold-up style for 5f sprint, apprentice Amie Waugh's 3lb claim provides useful weight relief

runners_data.name: Peggy Boo
runners_data.note: Unproven style makes tactical approach unclear, returning to 5f turf after disappointing 6f AW handicap debut 32 days ago
runners_data.comment: Low-key return last month (6f, AW); reverting to turf can help but has a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Just minor promise in three novice/maiden runs last year; well-beaten 28-1 shot on last month's handicap/seasonal return (6f, AW); returning to 5f on turf could help but she does have a point to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Victor Cee is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 8-runner field and will dictate proceedings from stall to finish without serious pace pressure. The prominent runners Soca Star, Naana's Shadow, Rotokura Belle, and Come On Over will track behind but none are natural gate speed merchants who will press early. This creates a moderate tempo where Victor Cee can control fractions through measured splits before the field closes late. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as hold-up horses will face a difficult task making up ground against runners already handy to Victor Cee's sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Victor Cee Leads
scenarios.trigger: If Victor Cee breaks cleanly and settles into an easy rhythm without early harassment from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: Victor Cee gets soft sectionals and kicks clear in the straight while the prominent runners struggle to reel him back from their tracking positions. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If two or more of Soca Star, Naana's Shadow, Rotokura Belle press Victor Cee from the gates creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits runners with tactical speed who can sit closer than usual, with Rotokura Belle and Naana's Shadow having the recent form edge to capitalize. Victor Cee may crack under sustained pressure having been off for 106 days.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to unleash sustained finishing kicks in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Paroda Diva and Moretons benefit from the patient ride as the early leaders wilt, though they still face the challenge of covering significant ground. The 5f trip demands they begin their moves earlier than ideal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Start Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Victor Cee misses the break or gets caught wide, creating early positional chaos among the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The race loses its tactical structure with multiple horses fighting for the lead, leading to a faster early pace that could set up an unlikely winner. Form horses may not handle the scrimmaging.

watchPoints.text: Victor Cee breaking slowly or getting caught wide would destroy the entire pace scenario and create tactical chaos
Watch if any of the prominent quartet Soca Star, Naana's Shadow, Rotokura Belle decide to press Victor Cee early and create genuine pace pressure
Monitor how quickly Paroda Diva and Moretons begin their closing moves as 5f leaves minimal time for hold-up tactics to develop
Rotokura Belle breaking from stall 8 again could cause positioning issues despite overcoming wide draw when winning here recently
Peggy Boo's undefined running style makes her positioning crucial to determine if she races prominently or from behind

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tide Lines
runners_data.note: Unknown running style but lightly-raced profile suggests potential upside with Charlie Johnston doing well recently

runners_data.name: King Of Roses
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 216-day break after poor debut but has been gelded since
runners_data.comment: Beaten 49l on September's 1m debut; gelded and up in trip but likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 5,000euros yearling; 22-1 and it was an inauspicious debut when beaten 49l in 1m Ayr novice (good to soft) in September; has been gelded and goes up in trip for this comeback, both of which might help, but probably one for further down the line.

runners_data.name: Lord
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader with German form but 356 days since last flat run, primarily a hurdler now
runners_data.comment: Won Listed juvenile hurdle in December; could go well on first British Flat start
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in conditions race (about 1m3f, good) on final start in Germany but he's better known as a hurdler and gained the latest of four wins in that sphere when taking Listed Aintree event (2m1f, soft) in December; wore cheekpieces when well beaten in Grade 1 this month but could go well switched back to the Flat; yard had a treble at Bangor on Saturday.

runners_data.name: Cranachan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing improved form at this trip, gelded since and Ralph Beckett 2/17 recently
runners_data.comment: Just 1l ahead of Mythical Valentine latest; likely close between them again; turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Had been gelded and was up in trip when showing a big chunk of improvement to be beaten a neck at Kempton (1m4f, AW; Mythical Valentine just 1l behind) on his reappearance in March; that was just his second start so reasonable to assume there's better to come; turf debut.

runners_data.name: Mythical Valentine
runners_data.note: Front-running style with modest improvement shown last time, Andrew Balding 7/30 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Just 1l behind Cranachan latest; might gain his revenge; turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Another to show improvement on his reappearance, finishing just 1l behind Cranachan when third at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in March; had to briefly wait for a run that day and there's unlikely to be much between the pair again; turf debut.

races.paceDynamic: Lord and Mythical Valentine will set the early pace in this small field, with both having confirmed front-running tendencies. Cranachan will sit prominently just behind the leaders, while King Of Roses and Tide Lines are likely to settle further back. The modest pace from two leaders over 1m4f should create an honest gallop without being overly strong early. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and closers, as the pace-setters may soften each other up and become vulnerable in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Cranachan can track the pace without being drawn into early battles
scenarios.body: The Ralph Beckett runner showed significant improvement last time at this trip and can exploit tired leaders. His prominent style is perfectly suited to pick off weakening front-runners Lord and Mythical Valentine.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Roses can overcome his poor debut and lengthy absence
scenarios.body: The hold-up runner benefits from the pace battle ahead and his German form suggests better ability than shown at Ayr. His style is ideally suited to a race where the early pace will set it up for closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Lord can dictate terms and see off Mythical Valentine early
scenarios.body: The German import has winning form at similar trips and may have too much class for this field. His front-running style succeeds if he can establish a clear lead and maintain it.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Tide Lines gets the perfect setup as a lightly-raced runner with unknown ability but potential upside. The Charlie Johnston stable angle and fresh legs could prove decisive in a slowly-run finish.

watchPoints.text: Lord and Mythical Valentine could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in early speed duel
King Of Roses faces significant fitness test returning after seven months off following poor debut
Cranachan carries momentum from improved Kempton effort where he narrowly failed at this distance
Tide Lines represents unknown quantity but Charlie Johnston's 2/38 record suggests confidence needed
Good going throughout the card should suit all runners with no obvious surface concerns

races.name: EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Enduring Story
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor recent AW form, needs significant improvement on turf return despite higher rating
runners_data.comment: Poor form in two AW runs this spring; no appeal switched to turf.
runners_data.spotlight: She has finished a well-beaten last in both AW runs this year (7f); switch to turf not enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: Le Puy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 204-day layoff after poor debut, likely needs this run to show true ability
runners_data.comment: Well-beaten 7th on Ayr debut (6f, soft) last September; bred to do much better in time
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1 for her Ayr debut last September (6f, soft) and dropped away to be beaten 22l; should do better in time but others look stronger in this field.

runners_data.name: Soda
runners_data.note: Unknown newcomer making debut, lightly raced concern but related to decent middle-distance winners
runners_data.comment: 4,000euros yearling; ninth foal with five winning siblings; market check advised
runners_data.spotlight: 4,000euros yearling; ninth foal; sister to 7f/1m winner Crossford (including 2yo/AW/Hong Kong; RPR 97), half-sister to four winners including So Suave (7f-8.5f including 2yo/AW; 96), Star Story (1m4f AW; 82) and Coloane (1m/8.6f; 69); dam 7f 2yo winner (92); enough paper appeal to warrant a market check in this field.

runners_data.name: Borjina
runners_data.note: Prominent style returning from 209-day break, showed promise last time and stable in excellent form
runners_data.comment: Promising 4th at Newcastle seven months ago; returns for a stable in fine form; unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging fourth in a 7f novice at Newcastle last September; now tackles her own sex and she returns from seven months off with her stable in fine form; leading player.

runners_data.name: Stella Lucente
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form in maidens, now tackling fillies-only company for first time
runners_data.comment: Runner-up, against male opposition, in two 7f AW maidens at Lingfield; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two 7f maidens at Lingfield (AW), the latest 26 days ago after a 205-day absence; now tackles a race confined to her own sex for the first time and she looks set to make another bold bid.

runners_data.name: Cotai Starlight
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was 5.5 lengths behind Got The Booty just 13 days ago, needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: 5.5l behind Got The Booty on recent stable debut (6f, AW); improvement essential
runners_data.spotlight: Similar form in two runs, the latest her stable debut 13 days ago (6f, Tapeta); has 5.5l to make up on Got The Booty on that run so improvement is essential.

runners_data.name: Got The Booty
runners_data.note: Natural leader improving with each run, 13 days since last start and clear tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: Second at Southwell on return two weeks ago; sets the standard and should stay an easy 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of her three starts (all 6f), recording an RPR of 73 when second of six (front two clear) at Southwell 13 days ago; open to further progress and this easy 7f should be in range; sets the standard.

races.paceDynamic: Got The Booty will lead this small field from the start, with no other natural front-runners to challenge her early dominance. Le Puy, Borjina and Stella Lucente are likely to settle in behind the leader in a compact group, while hold-up horses Enduring Story and Cotai Starlight will track from the rear. The lack of early pace pressure means Got The Booty can dictate fractions and kick for home when ready. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race with limited pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Got The Booty faces minimal early pressure and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and have enough left to resist late challenges. The prominent runners will be close enough but the leader's tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly stronger with multiple horses tracking close
scenarios.body: This creates a more even tempo that allows the prominent runners to stay within striking distance and time their challenges perfectly. Stella Lucente's recent form edge gives her the advantage in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Got The Booty goes too slowly early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a sprint finish from the back. Enduring Story's higher rating becomes relevant despite recent poor form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Soda shows significantly more ability than her breeding suggests on debut
scenarios.body: Her fresh legs and unknown quantity factor could prove decisive against more exposed rivals. The lack of early pace suits a newcomer who can position anywhere.

watchPoints.text: Got The Booty is non-runner despite being listed, completely changes the pace dynamic if confirmed out
Borjina returns from 209 days off but stable running at 25% strike-rate, fitness could be sharp
Soda makes debut for in-form Gemma Tutty yard, market support would indicate above-average ability
Enduring Story has been well-beaten in both runs this year, turf switch may not solve obvious problems
Stella Lucente drops to fillies-only company after two good seconds in mixed maidens

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Vince Le Prince
runners_data.note: Front runner with excellent C&D record but faces wall of closers in tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Good record over C&D; sold reappearance behind Evocative Spark two weeks ago; contender
runners_data.spotlight: His C&D record of 112153422 shows his affinity for the track and he made a pleasing return to action when second to the reopposing Evocative Spark here two weeks ago (pair clear); should make his presence felt again off an unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Jenni
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 190-day layoff with proven 7f turf form but needs fitness edge
runners_data.comment: On a good mark and conditions should be fine; ended 2025 quietly though
runners_data.spotlight: Twice a winner in 7f turf handicaps; 3lb lower than for last May's Musselburgh win but that is a result of ending 2025 with a whimper; she has an absence to defy and others look safer.

runners_data.name: Asian Journey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner still seeking first win but solid recent AW form translates well to this pace setup
runners_data.comment: Exposed maiden but he's more than capable off this mark if the cards fall right for him
runners_data.spotlight: Still seeking a first win after 14 attempts but he has been threatening to put that right on AW this year and he ran a solid race back on turf at Doncaster 24 days ago; a strongly run 7f should suit and he has a small race in him off this mark.

runners_data.name: Roundhay Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran prefers 6f nowadays but 176-day absence and proven course form creates interest
runners_data.comment: Veteran who returns from a 176-day absence over a trip that stretches him
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner who scored at Ripon (6f, soft) last July and is just 2lb higher on this reappearance outing; however, 6f has been this 11yo's optimum trip in recent seasons, and this is his first run since October.

runners_data.name: Habrdi
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly suited to this race shape with recent 7f Wolverhampton win showing current form
runners_data.comment: AW win off 7lb lower last month; two fair runs since; will need luck from stall 1
runners_data.spotlight: Hold-up handicapper who won a 7f Wolverhampton handicap off a 7lb lower mark last month; two creditable efforts have followed but he will need to raise his game to defy this mark and stall 1 will mean he needs some luck in running too.

runners_data.name: Evocative Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won last two races C&D including beating Vince Le Prince with identical tactics
runners_data.comment: Ready C&D win two weeks ago (Vince Le Prince second); faster ground to deal with this time
runners_data.spotlight: His last two wins have come over C&D, the latest when powering past Vince Le Prince in the final furlong two weeks ago; a 4lb rise seems less of a concern than good to firm ground, a surface he is rarely seen on.

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner seeking first handicap win but well-drawn low and race shape may not suit pressing style
runners_data.comment: Yet to win a handicap but he's well drawn and won't mind the return to fast turf
runners_data.spotlight: Still seeking a first handicap success but he went desperately close at Kempton last month (7f); not quite so good back at Kempton two weeks ago; well drawn for a prominent racer; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Simply Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up type coming off 6f AW win with 4lb rise but longer trip suits finishing kick perfectly
runners_data.comment: Led late in a 6f AW handicap 16 days ago; 7f no problem but 4lb higher in a better race
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark for James Owen at the 14th attempt when leading late on in a 6f handicap at Wolverhampton 16 days ago; returning to 7f no problem but a 4lb higher mark in a higher grade does ask more of him.

runners_data.name: Crocodile Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with four Catterick wins but all at 6f so trip question remains despite recent third C&D
runners_data.comment: Four-time course winner (6f, good or softer); promising return but this may not be his day
runners_data.spotlight: All four of his turf wins have come at Catterick but over 6f; creditable effort back from a break when third (5l behind Evocative Spark) two weeks ago; can build on that but perhaps vulnerable to stronger stayers.

races.paceDynamic: Vince Le Prince will take the field along from the front with Asian Journey and Tattie Bogle likely to track him in the early stages, creating a moderate gallop rather than fierce pressure. The pace should be sustainable through the middle stages before quickening from 2f out as the hold-up horses make their moves. With six of nine runners showing hold-up tendencies including recent C&D winner Evocative Spark, this race shape strongly favours closers who can deliver late kicks. The early leaders will face a wall of horses coming from behind in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop allows the six hold-up runners to close strongly, with superior finishing kicks deciding the outcome. Evocative Spark, Habrdi and Simply Blue benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Vince Le Prince faces minimal early pressure and gets soft fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader maintains enough in reserve to hold off late challengers, particularly given his proven C&D form. Asian Journey could also benefit from tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Asian Journey or Tattie Bogle position perfectly behind Vince Le Prince
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners avoid the late traffic problems that may hamper the hold-up brigade while having enough left to pass the leader. This tactical position proves optimal in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Vince Le Prince goes too slow early then the field sprints from 3f out
scenarios.body: The suddenly fierce tempo favours only the freshest horses with natural speed, creating an upset result. Roundhay Park's 176-day break could prove advantageous in these circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Evocative Spark faces 4lb rise but won this race two weeks ago using identical hold-up tactics against Vince Le Prince
Vince Le Prince could face severe tactical disadvantage with six hold-up horses targeting him in the closing stages
Asian Journey and Tattie Bogle's early positioning behind the leader will determine if they avoid late traffic problems
Simply Blue stepping up from 6f winning trip but James Owen's 5/48 record suggests each runner needs close scrutiny
Jenni returns from longest absence in field at 190 days but has two previous wins at this 7f trip on turf

races.name: Racing TV Profits Returned To Racing Handicap

runners_data.name: Aberama Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces traffic problems in small field, retains ability at 9 but tactical setup works against him
runners_data.comment: On a good mark and he was a solid 4th over C&D two weeks ago; should be involved again
runners_data.spotlight: Retains a large portion of his ability despite his advanced years and he is on a handy mark at present; no real excuses when fourth over C&D two weeks ago but this is a slightly weaker event.

runners_data.name: Dorney Lake
runners_data.note: Needs strong pace to close into but won't get it here, four turf wins suggest surface switch helps
runners_data.comment: Running himself back into form on AW; return to turf looks a major positive
runners_data.spotlight: Four 6f wins on good or faster turf; running himself into form on AW for his new yard this winter, most recently keeping on for third in a 0-80 at Southwell three weeks ago; 14lb lower than for his last turf outing; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Vingegaard
runners_data.note: Blinkers first time after 501-day absence, hold-up style unsuited to likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Useful 2yo but yet to shine for new yard after a long absence; now tried in blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Useful as 2yo for Archie Watson; absent for 501 days prior to three modest AW efforts for his new stable this year; dropped 11lb and now tried in blinkers so a revival isn't out of the question; not a solid option though.

runners_data.name: No Return
runners_data.note: Prominent style gives tactical edge, recent Lingfield second shows current form despite hood experiment
runners_data.comment: Good Lingfield second at start of year but below par since, beating one there latest
runners_data.spotlight: A fair ex-Irish 6f scorer in 2025; kickstarted this year with a good Lingfield second but below par since, hood tried when beating one back there 25 days ago; more is needed back on turf.

runners_data.name: Rosenpur
runners_data.note: Front runner with no early pace pressure, 170-day break and left-handed track form major positives
runners_data.comment: Five sprint wins around a left-hand bend last year; feasible mark for return; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Five wins, all around a left-hand bend (5f-5.5f; has form over much further), in a productive 2025 campaign; effective at this track and not impossibly treated returning from 170 days off; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Yorkshire Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent racer switching from winter AW success to turf off career-high mark, apprentice claim valuable
runners_data.comment: Gained superb ninth success of winter at Newcastle latest; player once more back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a superb ninth success of the winter in 6f Newcastle handicap 25 days ago; gamely making all; reverts to turf now off a career-high mark but he's a big player once more.

races.paceDynamic: Rosenpur is the sole confirmed front runner and will be allowed to bowl along at a comfortable tempo from the gates. No Return and Yorkshire Glory can sit prominent but neither has the pace to pressure Rosenpur early, creating a dream scenario for the leader. The four hold-up horses (Aberama Gold, Dorney Lake, Vingegaard) will be bunched at the back relying on a strong finish. This sustainable pace heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rosenpur Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur gets an uncontested lead as expected
scenarios.body: George Wood can dictate fractions and kick clear turning for home while the hold-up horses are still finding racing room. His left-handed track form and 170-day break become positives in this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If No Return or Yorkshire Glory can sit close enough to pounce
scenarios.body: The prominent pair avoid the inevitable traffic jam behind while staying within striking distance of Rosenpur's sustainable gallop. Yorkshire Glory's recent Newcastle success suggests he can handle this tactical scenario despite the turf return.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and racing room appears late
scenarios.body: Aberama Gold or Dorney Lake find clear water in the final furlong when the leaders tire. However, this requires perfect passage and a complete pace collapse that seems unlikely given the tactical makeup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all runners go steady from the start creating chaos
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse can win depending purely on luck in running. This scenario requires Rosenpur to go slow early which contradicts his natural front-running style.

watchPoints.text: Rosenpur getting loose on the front end - if he's 3+ lengths clear at halfway he may prove unbeatable
Yorkshire Glory's turf form translating from his winter AW dominance - surface switch is the key question

No Return's recent form dip continuing or bouncing back to his early season Lingfield promise
Vingegaard's first-time blinkers sparking improvement after three modest comeback runs

races.name: Racing Again 11th May Handicap

runners_data.name: Stellarmasterpiece
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with excellent course record though distance might just stretch her based on previous 1m6f efforts here
runners_data.comment: Fine track record but all wins at 1m4f; respected despite some stamina doubts
runners_data.spotlight: Fine track record although her four wins have all come at 1m4f; both goes over C&D looked to just stretch her last year but she did plug on when fourth here (1m4f) a fortnight ago and can never be ruled out at this place.

runners_data.name: Arctic Fox
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse returning from 176-day break but proven at this trip and has winning form on good ground
runners_data.comment: Trip no bother and mark fine too; can have an impact if ready after 176 days away
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time winner at up to this trip on varying ground, including soft; back on the same mark she scored from at Carlisle (1m6f, soft) in June; chance rests on whether she's ready to roll for this reappearance.

runners_data.name: Rock Armour
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who scored in first-time blinkers last time and showed promise with keeping-on third here previously
runners_data.comment: Kept on for third here (1m4f) a fortnight ago; new trip probably worth a go
runners_data.spotlight: In the hands of John Butler when sporting first-time blinkers to score at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in February; that's her only success but a keeping-on third here (1m4f, good) was a respectable effort a fortnight ago and this new trip is probably worth a go.

runners_data.name: Inlet
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from hurdling but limited turf form suggests others hold stronger claims
runners_data.comment: Has been hurdling with little joy for this yard; others of more interest back on the Flat
runners_data.spotlight: Has been hurdling for this new yard but yet to make an impact in that sphere; runner-up three times for Rae Guest (1m6f/2m, AW) but others hold greater interest on her return to this code.

runners_data.name: Nakatomi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner and 17-race maiden who finished fifth to Free Pic here a fortnight ago, wears visor
runners_data.comment: 17-race maiden who's capable of a fair effort but the visor needs to eke out a little more
runners_data.spotlight: 17-race maiden who's turned in a couple of fair efforts this year, including at this trip (AW) and when fifth to Free Pic here (1m4f, good) a fortnight ago; visor needs to eke out a little more, though.

runners_data.name: Free Pic
runners_data.note: Prominent style and only confirmed pace angle, coming off confidence-boosting win here two weeks ago
runners_data.comment: Won course handicap (1m4f, good) a fortnight ago; big player if her stamina holds out
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Newcastle in October and solid fourth there (also 1m4f, AW) in February; didn't stay 2m back at that track last month but a return to 1m4f did the trick when taking a course handicap (good) a fortnight ago; big player if her stamina lasts out.

runners_data.name: Regal Glory
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed promise when second at 1m6f debut over the trip at Wolverhampton recently
runners_data.comment: Good effort pver this trip when second (AW) last time; acts on turf too; respected
runners_data.spotlight: 1-36 but it was a good effort in second when tackling this trip for the first time at Wolverhampton (AW) a fortnight ago; acts on turf and needs considering.

runners_data.name: Rajawail
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who appears regressive and very difficult to fancy from this position
runners_data.comment: Regressive maiden who is very difficult to fancy from out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive maiden who is very difficult to fancy from out of the weights.

races.paceDynamic: Free Pic and Nakatomi are the only prominent runners in this small field, with Free Pic likely to set the tempo having shown clear front-running tendencies and coming off a confidence-boosting win. With six of eight runners carrying hold-up styles, there will be minimal early pressure allowing Free Pic to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Stellarmasterpiece, Arctic Fox, Rock Armour, Inlet, Regal Glory and Rajawail will create a bunched field turning for home before the typical late charge unfolds. This race shape clearly favours horses with proven finishing kicks and hold-up tactics, as they'll benefit from the modest early pace and have optimal conditions to unleash their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Free Pic sets uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses get the perfect setup they crave
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up runners will have ideal conditions to time their challenges, with the moderate early pace suiting closers perfectly. Stellarmasterpiece and Arctic Fox are best positioned to capitalize with their proven course form and finishing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Free Pic Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Free Pic gets away with very soft fractions and kicks again when the field comes to him
scenarios.body: His recent winning form suggests confidence is high and minimal early pressure could allow him to have enough left for the finish. The lack of other genuine pace angles gives him every chance to control the race on his terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates a wall of horses and blocks several fancied runners
scenarios.body: With so many horses needing room to maneuver late, some will get better passages than others through the pack. An unfancied hold-up horse like Rock Armour could benefit from a cleaner run while others struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Nakatomi Prominent Play
scenarios.trigger: If Nakatomi goes more aggressively early to support Free Pic and creates genuine pressure
scenarios.body: This would create a stronger pace that could set up the race for the fastest finisher among the hold-up horses. However, Nakatomi lacks the class to sustain this role effectively given his maiden status.
